newsitem.title: USA: Bitwise says will sell unit, won't sell stock.
newsitem.headline: Bitwise says will sell unit, won't sell stock.

text.p: Bitwise Designs Inc said Thursday it agreed to sell substantially all of the assets of its wholly-owned subsidary, Electrograph Systems Inc, to Manchester Equipment Co Inc.
Bitwise said the deal is for $2.5 million in cash, plus the settlement of certain intercompany liabilities owed by Electrograph to Bitwise.

Bitwise said they had announced on March 11 that a letter of intent had been signed. The company said Manchester has formed a wholly-owned subsidiary to acquire the assets, which will also assume substantially all of the liabilities of Electrograph.
The company said they expect to close the deal no later than April 30.
Bitwise also said it had ended talks with an institutional investor for the private sale of $5 million of senior convertible stock and common stock purchase warrants.
Bitwise said current market conditions made the terms of the proposed investment unacceptable.
The company said it will continue to explore other financing opportunities in the future.
